traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and explicit requirements in docs/stories/002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG.story.md are fully implemented and verified: - Recommended and strict flat-config presets are implemented in src/index.ts and exposed via plugin.configs as ESLint v9 flat-config arrays. - Integration with ESLint v9 flat configuration is demonstrated through both automated tests using FlatESLint and comprehensive documentation (README and ESLint 9 Setup Guide), covering JS, TS, mixed projects, and monorepos. - Configuration options for rules (notably valid-story-reference and require-story-annotation) are defined with JSON Schema, validated in tests, and produce clear error messages on invalid configuration, fulfilling REQ-RULE-OPTIONS and REQ-CONFIG-VALIDATION and the Error Handling acceptance criterion. - Customization of story paths and locations (REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS) is provided by valid-story-reference options (storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, requireStoryExtension) and thoroughly tested. - User-facing docs give clear setup guidance, multiple configuration patterns, and troubleshooting, satisfying the User Experience and Documentation acceptance criteria. - The full Jest test suite, including the three story-specific config tests, passes successfully. There is no evidence of regression or missing behavior for this story.
Therefore, this story is correctly and completely implemented.
